title: Thanks for Your Enquiry | Garage Doors Milton Keynes
meta: Thanks for getting in touch with Garage Doors Milton Keynes. We have your details and will be in touch soon to arrange your free survey and quote.
hero_sub: We'll be in touch shortly to talk about your garage door. If it's urgent, give us a call.
body:
What happens next

We'll read through your details and get back to you, usually the same working day, to arrange a convenient time for a free survey or to talk through your repair.

In the meantime you might find these useful: our garage door price guide, the guide to types of garage doors and our repairs page.

Helpful things to have ready

  • A photo of the door from outside, and one from inside if you can
  • Rough width and height of the opening (we'll measure properly at the survey)
  • Whether there's a power socket in the garage, if you want an electric door
  • For repairs, a short description of what the door is doing

While you wait, you might also like our guides on whether to repair or replace and electric garage door costs, or browse all garage door types.
